title: The Marathas of Thanjavur
subtitle: A Maratha kingdom in the Tamil country · 1675 – 1855
subject: thanjavur-maratha
intro: In 1675 Ekoji (Venkoji), Shivaji's half-brother and commander of Bijapur's army in the south, took Thanjavur from its Nayak rulers. His descendants ruled the Kaveri delta for 180 years as patrons of Tamil, Telugu, Sanskrit and Marathi learning, music and dance — above all Serfoji II, whose Saraswathi Mahal Library survives.

members.note: Deposed by the Nawab of Arcot 1773–1776
From 1799 rules only the fort and capital; the British govern the kingdom

events.title: Ekoji takes Thanjavur
events.summary: After the Madurai Nayak overruns Thanjavur, a Nayak prince appeals to Bijapur. Ekoji, sent to help, takes the kingdom for himself.

events.title: Shivaji claims a share
events.summary: During his southern campaign Shivaji demands half of Shahaji's southern inheritance from Ekoji; the brothers reach a settlement after fighting.

events.title: Shahuji I's court
events.summary: Shahuji I, himself a poet, makes Thanjavur a centre of Telugu and Marathi literature and music.

events.title: British attack Devikottai
events.summary: The East India Company's first military campaign in the south is an attack on Thanjavur's fort of Devikottai.

events.title: Taken by the Nawab of Arcot
events.summary: The Nawab of Arcot, with Company troops, captures Thanjavur and imprisons Thuljaji; the Company's directors restore him in 1776.

events.title: Serfoji under Schwarz's care
events.summary: When the regent Amar Singh takes the throne, the young heir Serfoji is protected and educated by the Danish missionary Christian Friedrich Schwarz.

events.title: Kingdom ceded to the British
events.summary: Serfoji II is installed with British support and then signs over the administration of the kingdom, keeping the capital and fort with a pension.

events.title: Marathi inscription at the Brihadisvara temple
events.summary: Serfoji II records the history of his dynasty in a long Marathi inscription on the walls of the Brihadisvara temple.

events.title: Saraswathi Mahal Library
events.summary: Serfoji II greatly expands the palace library and sets up one of the first printing presses in south India using Devanagari type.

events.title: Annexed by the British
events.summary: Shivaji of Thanjavur dies without a son and the British annex the remaining principality.
